name: Sichuan Zhonghe Import and Export Trade Co. Ltd.
supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list names Sichuan Zhonghe Import and Export Trade among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP). The US Commerce Department added it to the Entity List in 2020, citing its procurement of US-origin items, as one of ten entities owned by, operated by or directly affiliated with CAEP, the complex responsible for researching, developing and testing China’s nuclear weapons; the listing places it at two addresses on Chengdu’s First Ring Road.
